headline: Why our Pad Thai tastes different
---

Most street stalls buy their Pad Thai sauce ready-made by the bucket.
We cook ours twice a week ourselves — from tamarind, palm sugar and
fish sauce, in the exact ratio Mae Som’s mother taught her fifty years ago.

It takes two hours. It's worth it every single time.
